fullContentHtml:
Short Information : Bank of Baroda (BOB) has released the notification for the post of Sales Manager, Officer Agriculture Sales & Manager Agriculture Sales. This recruitment has been issued for 417 posts. Online applying process for Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Recruitment 2025 has started from 06 August 2025 & the candidates can apply till 26 August 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Recruitment 2025 which has given below. 

Bank of Baroda (BOB)

Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Recruitment 2025

Advt No. : BOB/ HRM/ REC/ ADVT/ 2025/11

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 06 August 2025
  • Last Date : 26 August 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 26 August 2025
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 850/-
  • SC, ST  : Rs. 175/-
  • All Female : Rs. 175/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Notification 2025 : Age Limit

  • Age Limit As On 01 August 2025
  • Sales Manager : 24-34 Years
  • Agriculture Sales Officer : 24-36 Years
  • Agriculture Sales Manager : 26-42 Years
  • Age Relaxation as per Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Recruitment Rules.
  • Use Tool –

Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer 2025 : Vacancy Details

Total Posts : 417 Posts

Post Name No. of Post
Manager Sales 227
Officer Agriculture Sales 142
Manager Agriculture Sales 48

Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Recruitment 2025 : Educational Qualification

Post Name Eligibility 
Manager Sales
  • Candidates who have Bachelor Degree in Any Stream from any recognized University in India will be eligible for this recruitment.
  • Minimum -03- Years of experience in Sales in Banking and Financial institutions exclusively in liabilities products.
  • Preferred : MBA / PGDM in Marketing / Sales / Banking
Officer Agriculture Sales
  • Candidates who have 4-Year Degree in Agriculture / Horticulture / Animal Husbandry / Veterinary Science / Dairy Science / Fishery Science / Pisciculture / Agri. Marketing & Cooperation / Cooperation & Banking / Agro-Forestry / Forestry/ Agricultural Biotechnology / B.Tech Biotechnology / Food Science / Agriculture Business Management / Food Technology / Dairy Technology /Agricultural Engineering/ Sericulture / Fisheries Engineering.
  • Minimum -01- Year experience in Agri Sales, preferably in BFSI.
  • Preferable: Two Year Full Time Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Sales /Marketing /Agri Business /Rural Management/Finance
Manager Agriculture Sales
  • Candidates who have 4-Year Degree in Agriculture / Horticulture / Animal Husbandry / Veterinary Science / Dairy Science / Fishery Science / Pisciculture / Agri. Marketing & Cooperation / Cooperation & Banking / Agro-Forestry / Forestry/ Agricultural Biotechnology / B.Tech Biotechnology / Food Science / Agriculture Business Management / Food Technology / Dairy Technology /Agricultural Engineering/ Sericulture / Fisheries Engineering.
  • Minimum -03- Years’ experience in Agri Sales, preferably in BFSI.
  • Preferable: Two Year Full Time Post Graduate Degree or Diploma in Sales /Marketing /Agri Business /Rural Management/Finance

Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer Online Form 2025 : How To Apply

  • Candidates can apply through link https://www.bankofbaroda.in/ or provided below in link section or they can also apply through official site of the Bank of Baroda before Last Date.
  • You Can Check other Sarkari Result 2025 Notification Here – Check Now.
  • For all the interested and eligible candidates who want to apply for Bank of Baroda Sales Manager & Officer recruitment can read all the information related to the recruitment is given below and the link to apply is given in the Important Link section below.
